scripts.build: bun run build:client && bun run build:react && bun run build:vue && bun run build:vanilla && bun run build:angular && bun scripts/assemble-package.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:client && bun run build:react && bun run build:vue && bun run build:vanilla && bun check --no-script && bun run -F @last-notifications-widgets/client typecheck && bun run -F @last-notifications-widgets/react typecheck && bun run -F @last-notifications-widgets/vue typecheck && bun run -F @last-notifications-widgets/vanilla typecheck && bun run -F @last-notifications-widgets/angular typecheck
scripts.test:bell: bun run build && bun scripts/check-bell.ts react && bun scripts/check-bell.ts vue && bun scripts/check-bell.ts vanilla && bun scripts/check-bell.ts angular
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test
scripts.release: bun run check && bun run build && bun run package:check && changeset publish
